note:
Reviewed opposing identities: Japanese military transports opposed Russian Vladivostok cruisers. The sources identify the force identities and equipment families; the review does not treat transported soldiers as ship counts or turn incomplete vessel-loss reports into complete casualty totals. Unavailable quantities stay empty, so these identities support an illustrative engagement rather than proportional forces.

Equipment review: Japan receives a troop-transport silhouette, supported by the Greenwich transport photographs and the contemporary report naming Hitachi Maru and Sado Maru. Russia receives an armoured-cruiser family analogy for the Vladivostok raiders. The miniature does not reproduce individual Russian gun layouts; transport numbers and crew losses are not inferred.
